name: Phoenix Leap · Earth
primary:
Dash where you look. On you:
• Damage 2.25 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 6.75 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Stone skin (Resistance III) for 10 s
For half a second you leave a trail of 1-block zones lasting 2 s; every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Damage 4.5 ❤ fire + 2.25 ❤ arcane + 3 ❤ earth (fire ×0.5 on wet, earth ×2 on frozen)
• Heat: sets on fire for 21.6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Heals 1.75 ❤
• Regeneration: +0.5 ❤ every 2 s for 9 s
• Growth: up to 5 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 6.75 s
• Revives the nearest fallen player or creature within 5.22 blocks with 39% health
• Puts out fire
• Brittle (earth damage ×2) for 9 s
